transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because for months now I’ve been noticing the same kind of pattern. My sister’s appointments get moved, bills come in wrong, people say they “forgot” to call me back. Everyone keeps telling me it’s just mistakes, but it doesn’t feel like that to me. I know information is being kept from me, and it feels like they’re trying to push me out of decisions.
Can you tell me more about why you believe people are keeping information from you and trying to push you out of decisions?

It’s the pattern of it. One thing by itself could be a mistake, I understand that. But for months, it’s been the same kind of thing over and over—my sister’s appointments get changed and I’m not told, bills come in with things wrong, people say they forgot to call me back.

And when I ask about it, everyone acts like I’m overreacting or says it was just an accident. But it doesn’t feel accidental anymore. It feels like information is being kept from me, and like they’re trying to make decisions without me or push me out of them.
Have you ever felt that people are acting together or working against you in a way that others don’t seem to notice?

Yes. That’s what it feels like to me. I can’t say I’ve caught people sitting in a room planning it, but the way the same things keep happening—appointments moved, bills wrong, calls not returned—it feels coordinated. Other people keep saying it’s just mistakes, but I don’t believe that anymore. It feels like they’re keeping things from me and making decisions without me.

Have you ever experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices that others don’t hear, seeing things that aren’t there, or believing something strongly that others say isn’t true—even when there’s no clear reason for it?

I don’t hear voices or see things, no. But yes, I do believe this is happening even though other people keep telling me it’s just mistakes. For months it’s been the same pattern—my sister’s appointments get moved, bills come in wrong, people don’t call me back—and I know information is being kept from me. It feels like they’re trying to push me out of decisions.
Do you believe that these events are happening specifically to send you a message or because you are being targeted for a particular reason?

I don’t think it’s like they’re sending me some hidden message. It’s more that I feel I’m being targeted in the sense that they’re keeping information from me and trying to push me out of decisions.

It’s the same pattern I keep seeing—my sister’s appointments get moved, bills show up wrong, people “forget” to call me back—and everyone says it’s just mistakes, but I don’t believe that anymore.
Do you believe that these things are happening even though others have shown you evidence that they are not?

Yes. Even when people show me something that’s supposed to explain it, I still don’t really believe it. It’s been going on for months—the appointments being moved, bills wrong, calls not returned. Everyone keeps saying it’s just mistakes, but it feels like the same pattern, and I know information is being kept from me and I’m being pushed out of decisions.
Do you believe that people are deliberately conspiring against you in a way that you can't see direct proof of, but that you feel certain is happening?

Yes, I do. I can’t point to one piece of proof that would convince everyone, but after months of the same things happening—my sister’s appointments getting moved, bills coming in wrong, people not calling me back—I don’t believe it’s all accidental. It feels deliberate, like they’re keeping information from me and trying to push me out of decisions.
